decisions.statement: A path absent at the ref hashes as the literal string absent.
The digest is taken over path=objectid lines in the order the sources give.
A rev-list that fails is answered as a count of zero commits.
A ref naming no commit is answered as nothing rather than as a throw.
Origin reaches a commit where a remote-tracking ref of origin contains the commit.
The code repo's build inputs are a fixed hand-written list of five paths.
A fetch of origin is named here, so every caller names it the same way.

definition: a sha256 over the git object ids named paths carry at a ref
